snippet.title: Waltz and Jam - Release Date & Demo Launch Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Waltz and Jam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2686570/Waltz_and_Jam/

Waltz and Jam launches December 3rd on Steam, Nintendo Switch 2 and PlayStation 5. Play the demo now on Steam!

Every adventure is better with a dog, even in the afterlife! 👻🐶 Waltz and Jam is an action-adventure platformer following Waltz, a pure-hearted soul, and Jam, his lovable shape-shifting puppy.  Team up to bounce, splash, and puzzle your way through seven hand-painted storybook worlds inspired by the Seven Deadly Sins.

Waltz and Jam Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2686570/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019609
Nintendo: https://nintendo.com/us/store/products/waltz-and-jam-switch-2

--

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
